project_type: Next.js 16 full-stack app with App Router, API routes, Prisma ORM, OpenAI integration
build_system: npm with Next.js build. postinstall runs prisma generate. No Dockerfile.
build_command: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npm run build
test_command: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build with POSTGRES_URL placeholder. 2. Run npx vitest run. 3. Run npm run lint.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by prisma generate (gitignored). No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npm install && npx prisma generate
environment_constraints: No database available at runtime (POSTGRES_URL not set). Tests must mock DB. Build requires POSTGRES_URL placeholder for type generation. Use 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22' before any node/npm commands.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. CI runs lint then build. No tests currently.
key_patterns: API routes use NextRequest/NextResponse pattern in src/app/api/*/route.ts. Error handling is inconsistent - some routes leak err.message, some return generic errors. The gc/commands route has a simple bearer token auth pattern (GC_AUTH_TOKEN). Prisma client uses lazy proxy pattern in src/lib/db.ts. LLM calls use OpenAI SDK with gpt-4o-mini for parsing and gpt-4o for generation.
directory_structure: src/app/api/ - 44 API route files across jobs, companies, experience, phrases, resume/*, skills/*, profile/*, parse-job, parse-skills, health, sentinel, integrity, gc/*. src/lib/ - shared utilities (db, parsers, taxonomy, slugify, normalize-company). src/components/ - React components. src/generated/prisma/ - generated Prisma client. prisma/ - schema.prisma + seed. .github/workflows/ - ci.yml + schema-push.yml.
